name: Persistence
description: Store data you wish to persist between container rebuilds.

directories.description: Colon separated list of directory paths to persist via symlink.

files.description: Colon separated list of file paths to persist via symlink.

bindDirectories.description: Colon separated list of directory paths to persist via bind mount, for tools that replace symlinks (e.g. ~/.claude). Requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN.

bindFiles.description: Colon separated list of file paths to persist via bind mount, for tools that replace symlinks (e.g. ~/.claude.json). Requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
